scope: Planned, schedulable care. Emergency visit codes (CPT 99281-99292) and ambulance (HCPCS A0xxx) excluded.
source: Hospital machine-readable files published under 45 CFR Part 180

shard.withheldRule: Any published value that rounds to one cent or less is carried in `w`, flagged, never displayed as a price and never used in a comparison.

audit.localCodeRule: A code published under a column that is not CPT/HCPCS/MS-DRG is used only when its shape is a CPT (5 digits) or HCPCS Level II (letter + 4 digits) AND the same code is published under a proper code column by some hospital in this release.

export.codeScope: ( ( ic.code_type_norm IN ('CPT','MS-DRG','HCPCS') AND ( ic.code_type_norm <> 'CPT' OR (ic.code_norm ~ '^[0-9]{5}$' AND NOT (ic.code_norm BETWEEN '99281' AND '99292')) ) AND ( ic.code_type_norm <> 'HCPCS' OR ic.code_norm !~ '^A0' ) ) OR (ic.code_norm ~ '^[0-9]{5}$' AND NOT (ic.code_norm BETWEEN '99281' AND '99292')) OR (ic.code_norm ~ '^[ABDEGHJKLMPQRSTVU][0-9]{4}$' AND ic.code_norm !~ '^A0') )
